crossRefs.note: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

translations.web: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
translations.bsb: and say to the elders, “This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
translations.kjv: And they shall say unto the elders of his city, This our son is stubborn and rebellious, he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton, and a drunkard.
